The gate's 16 newly passing tests are consistent with a change of this size, and the remaining 14 failures come from the missing ArrayBuffer.prototype.slice. I could not inspect the rest of the crate, so I am relying on two unverified assumptions. First, that array_buffer_byte_length is derived from the data block rather than stored separately, so that step 15 holds.
